# Proposal for BrightRoom

Thank you for your enquiry. Here is our recommended setup for your event.

## Recommended venue: the Loft
Because you need wheelchair access, the Loft is the right choice. Our Studio is stairs-only and not wheelchair accessible.

- 4-hour booking
- Capacity up to 24 people, so 10 guests fit comfortably
- Wheelchair accessible
- Wi-Fi included

## Itemised quote

| Item | Calculation | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Loft (4 hours) | flat | €420 |
| Coffee break | 10 people × €8 | €80 |
| Projector | flat, one for the booking | €35 |
| **Total** | | **€535** |

All prices are final totals in euros, with no taxes or extra fees.

## Budget
The total of **€535 is €65 under your €600 budget.**

For reference, adding lunch for all 10 attendees (€180) would bring the total to €715, which is over budget. A facilitator (€280) would also exceed it. Neither is included in this quote.

## Next step
**Availability:** We haven't checked availability yet, so this quote isn't a confirmed booking. Please send us your preferred date (and an alternative if possible) and we'll check it.

We look forward to hosting you at BrightRoom.
